item.title: Version 1.0.26
item.description:
fixes:

- Stops the false "FLIP FAILED · TAP TO RETRY" banner from
  showing after a successful UNFLIP.  Old behavior: stale apiError
  from a previous attempt persisted across the unflip transition,
  so "Phone is free" rendered with a contradictory red error
  banner.  Now endFlip clears the error too.

- Emergency unflip is now available in any committed time-bound
  session — Focus, Unplug ModesView, Nomad, Social — not just
  Focus.  Forever sessions still refuse by design.  Cooldown copy
  fixed: was "3 days between uses", now reads "1 per month" /
  "30 days" matching the actual backend rule.

Includes everything from 1.0.25 (email + 6-digit code sign-in)
and 1.0.24 (backend pre-flight health check).
